extracted.intended_audience: researchers and authors conducting Cochrane systematic reviews of interventions; evidence synthesis teams; guideline developers
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and methodological guidance for planning, conducting, analysing, reporting, updating, and presenting systematic reviews of interventions following the Cochrane Handbook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a Cochrane Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter II: Planning a Cochrane Review — guidance on initial planning tasks required to start a Cochrane review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting the review
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter III: Reporting the review — standards and recommendations for how to report the methods and findings of a Cochrane review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Considerations and recommendations for figures in Cochrane reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: III.S1 Supplementary material: Considerations and recommendations for figures in Cochrane reviews: graphs of statistical data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance for writing a Cochrane Plain language summary
rubrics_metrics.description: III.S2 Supplementary material: Guidance for writing a Cochrane Plain language summary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter IV: Updating the review — guidance on when and how to update a systematic review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overviews of Reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter V: Overviews of Reviews — guidance on producing overviews (umbrella reviews) of multiple systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Starting a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Part 2 / Chapter 1: Starting a review — initial steps and setup for conducting a review.

rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 3: Defining the criteria for including studies and how they will be grouped for the synthesis — eligibility criteria and grouping strategies for synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 4: Searching for and selecting studies — methods for designing and conducting literature searches and selecting studies for inclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching: Appendix of resources
rubrics_metrics.description: 4.S2 Supplementary material: Appendix of resources — supplementary resources to support searching and selection.

rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 6: Choosing effect measures and computing estimates of effect — selecting appropriate effect measures and how to compute effect estimates.
